title: T1489 — Service Stop
subtitle: Watch the attack unfold on a compromised application server, and see at the same time what the SOC can observe.

steps.title: OF 8 - SHELL WITH STOLEN CREDS
steps.caption: The attacker signs in to APP01 with an admin account stolen by an infostealer and opens a shell. Nothing looks broken yet, but they now hold the keys to the services.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Compare every admin logon source with your jump host list and alert on the rest.

steps.title: OF 8 - MAP THE SERVICES
steps.caption: The attacker runs sc query and tasklist /svc to list services and their processes. They pick targets: protection, backup, and database services go on the list.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Flag service enumeration from an interactive admin session on a server.

steps.title: OF 8 - DEFENDER STOP FAILS
steps.caption: The attacker runs net stop WinDefend, but tamper protection blocks the stop. The attempt still lands in the logs, and the SOC sees someone testing the protection.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Alert on any attempt to stop security services, even when it fails.

steps.title: OF 8 - SYSMON STOPS
steps.caption: The attacker runs net stop Sysmon64. The logging service has no tamper protection, so it stops and System event 7036 records it. The host's telemetry stops, and the SOC view shows a missing line.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Treat a silent log source as an alert, not as a network fault.

steps.title: OF 8 - FREE THE LOCKED FILES
steps.caption: The attacker stops the SQL Writer and the backup agent. These services hold data files locked open, so stopping them frees the files for encryption minutes later.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Page when backup or SQL services stop outside a change window.

steps.title: OF 8 - THE BULK STOP STORM
steps.caption: A script stops a dozen services in seconds: web, print, time, update, and more. Service boxes gray out one after another and System 7036 events pour into the log.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Alert on the burst pattern, ten or more stops in minutes, not on each event.

steps.title: OF 8 - SIEM LINKS THE FACTS
steps.caption: The SIEM links three facts from one host: the 7036 burst, the lost heartbeat, and the failed Defender stop. It raises one critical incident instead of a pile of noise.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Build this correlation rule before the attack, with host and account in the alert.

steps.title: OF 8 - ISOLATE AND RESTORE
steps.caption: The SOC isolates APP01, blocks the stolen account, and restarts the stopped services from a clean session. Data comes back from the immutable backup copy the attacker never reached.
steps.defender: Defender hint: Check 7040 events so disabled services do not stay off after reboot.
